title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**About Us**




 Exotel is the emerging market’s leading full\-stack customer engagement platform and business\-focused virtual telecom operator. Founded in 2011, our cloud\-based product suite powers over 50 million daily engagements across voice, video, and messaging channels.
 



 Trusted by 6,000\+ companies across 60\+ countries—including India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa—Exotel enables unified customer engagement for leading businesses such as Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, GoJek, Byju’s, HDFC Bank, Zomato, and Urban Company. Our offerings include communication APIs, a modern omnichannel contact centre, and a conversational AI platform hosted on the cloud. We are a Series D company valued at $100 million with $60 million in ARR.
 



  





**About the Pod**




 This role sits directly within our product pod, managing the end\-to\-end technical delivery of Conversational Quality Assurance (CQA) products. Unlike broader corporate delivery tracks, this position has direct ownership of enterprise implementations from initiation to completion, serving as the bridge between cutting\-edge AI product performance and enterprise execution.
 



  





**About the Role**




 We are seeking an Technical Project Manager to fully own the end\-to\-end execution, delivery processes, and client communication for our CQA product line. In this role, you will step into a key leadership position within the pod, managing all technical communication with incoming enterprise customers, translating their expectations into functional workflows, and driving internal execution.
 



 As the delivery lead, you will have direct ownership of the project lifecycle. You will balance high\-stakes stakeholder management with a deep technical understanding of cloud telecom ecosystems and frontier AI.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Delivery Ownership \& Team Leadership** 



* Take absolute end\-to\-end ownership of the CQA product delivery process, relieving leadership from daily execution tasks.
* Establish, optimize, and enforce robust project management processes tailored for large, complex enterprise clients.



**2\. Client \& Technical Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the primary, front\-facing technical interface for onboarding enterprise clients.
* Lead client discover sessions to extract, understand, and document technical requirements from a product standpoint.
* Drive alignment and manage timelines across multiple external and internal stakeholders, ensuring projects move forward without bottlenecks.



**3\. Technical Project Execution** 



* Oversee the complex integration of CQA products into Exotel’s existing telecom/API ecosystem.
* Ensure smooth deployment and operational validation of frontier GenAI and LLM applications within the clients' environments.
* Coordinate daily with engineering, pre\-sales, and delivery teams, facilitating a seamless post\-delivery handover to Support Engineers.



  





**What We’re Looking For**




**Experience \& Core Competencies** 



* 5 to 8 years of solid project management experience, explicitly within software, SaaS, or deep technical product delivery.
* Proven track record of managing and delivery implementations for large enterprise customers.



**Technical Skillset** 



* AI \& Frontier Tech: Strong familiarity with AI/ML, NLP, conversational AI concepts, and hands\-on exposure to GenAI (prompt engineering, LLM applications).
* Integrations \& Infrastructure: Deep understanding of integration methods for CRMs, APIs, cloud systems, architecture, and deployment methodologies.
* Systems Knowledge: Comfortable understanding what works and what doesn't across Linux, networking, databases, message queues, and caching.



**Soft Skills \& Process Drive** 



* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills—capable of driving technical discussions with enterprise executives and internal engineers alike.
* High level of accountability, organizational rigor, and time management.
* A proactive, customer\-focused approach to problem\-solving and risk mitigation.

description:
Role Overview
 



 We're looking for a
 **Senior Project Manager** 
 to drive global marketing execution with absolute precision, speed, and total clarity.
 



 This isn't a passive tracking role—we're looking for an obsessively detail\-oriented operator with an uncompromising work ethic who sets the operational tempo for the entire organization. You thrive on structure, sweat every minor detail, and hold Directly Responsible Individuals (DRIs) relentlessly accountable across global functions and time zones.
 



 Crucially, you don't just rely on legacy project management habits. You actively leverage AI tools and automation to eliminate friction, optimize workflows, predict bottlenecks, and keep our marketing machine running at full velocity. You own the timelines, the tools, and the operating rhythm, constantly refining them to set a new standard of operational excellence.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



 Operational Rigor \& Accountability
 


* **Set the Tempo \& Own DRIs:** 
 Establish a clear, high\-velocity operational rhythm. Track every action item to its owner and hold DRIs accountable for milestones and deliverables across global marketing functions, including Creative, Social, PR, Retail, Influencer, Digital, and Regional teams.
* **Obsessive Precision \& Execution:** 
 Build and maintain comprehensive launch calendars, detailed workback plans, status trackers, and dependency maps to ensure flawless execution.
* **Lead High\-Efficiency IMC Syncs:** 
 Facilitate structured, action\-oriented Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) meetings with clear outcomes, strong accountability, and cross\-functional alignment.
* **Proactive Risk Mitigation:** 
 Identify bottlenecks, dependencies, and execution risks early, taking corrective actions before they impact launch timelines.



 AI \& Workflow Optimization
 


* **AI\-Powered Operations:** 
 Identify, implement, and scale AI\-powered solutions for automated reporting, meeting summaries, predictive scheduling, task routing, and workflow optimization to improve operational efficiency.
* **Systems \& Process Architecture:** 
 Develop standardized ways of working, reusable frameworks, and comprehensive documentation, including project kickoffs, scope documents, execution playbooks, and post\-launch reviews.
* **Tool Mastery:** 
 Serve as the subject matter expert for project management platforms such as Notion, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, and Gantt tools, while driving adoption and best practices across teams.



 Global Alignment \& Continuous Improvement
 


* **Global\-Local Coordination:** 
 Partner closely with regional teams to ensure launch readiness, local market adaptation, and seamless execution across multiple geographies and time zones.
* **Post\-Mortems \& Optimization:** 
 Lead launch retrospectives, document key learnings, refine operational playbooks, and continuously improve future execution standards.



  





 What We're Looking For
 


* **7\+ years** 
 of experience managing large\-scale, cross\-functional marketing projects or complex product launches, preferably within technology, mobile, consumer electronics, or other fast\-paced consumer brands.
* Exceptional attention to detail with a relentless commitment to accuracy, consistency, ownership, and execution excellence.
* Demonstrated ability to lead with urgency, discipline, and a strong work ethic while driving operational excellence across teams.
* Hands\-on experience using
 **AI tools and prompt engineering** 
 to automate project management activities, streamline documentation, summarize meetings, identify risks, and improve operational efficiency.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive accountability across cross\-functional teams without creating unnecessary friction.
* Advanced proficiency with modern project management platforms such as
 **Notion, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Jira** 
 , and workflow automation tools such as
 **Zapier** 
 and
 **Make** 
 .
* Proven experience managing global stakeholders and coordinating projects across multiple regions and time zones.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly, concisely, and effectively in a fast\-paced global environment.

description:
**Standing at the forefront of project delivery**
 As the person in charge, you’ll assemble and lead various project teams, and establish effective organisational structure and working procedures for the teams. This role demands efficient project management skills, which you’ll exhibit by identifying the projects’ objectives and allotting sufficient budget, to achieve optimal results and meet the company’s target profits.
   

  

 Likewise, you’ll be in charge of managing and monitoring the different stages of the projects—from their pre\-design phase up to their completion. Furthermore, your proven track record in project management will come in handy, as you’ll be in charge of facilitating negotiations, analyses and meetings with authorities.
   

  

**Creating lasting client relationships**
 This role asks the question “How can I contribute even more to the company’s growth?” You’ll do this by establishing strong business relationships with our clients. To build lasting connection with our clients, you’ll identify and work around their needs and constraints. You’ll also represent their interests effectively throughout the whole project duration. Additionally, you’ll be in charge of retaining new business contacts and repeat businesses from new investors or landlord clients within an agreed time period.
   

  

**Promoting JLL in every opportunity**
 Will you act as the face of our business? If so, we’d be happy to take you on board. In this role, you’ll see to it that our company is represented throughout the project. You’ll do this by promoting our business offerings to new prospects, key local landlord clients, business investor networks and industry landlord associations.
   

  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**
**Our successful Project Managers …**
* Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their perspective.
* Are driven to succeed and love achieving challenging goals.
* Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
* Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
* Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.


**An exceptional leader**
 This role demands high\-level management skills—that’s why an ideal candidate should have a degree in relevant property\-related discipline, with a minimum of 15 years’ experience in design, construction and project management.
   

  

 This role also calls for an in\-depth understanding of local codes and legislation, and demands that you carry out consultations, analyses and assessments. Furthermore, you’ll ensure the effective delegation of responsibility and authority within the teams.
   

  

 Are you an effective decision maker? In this role, you should be able to make tough decisions that resolve problems or improve operations.
   

  

**A strong communicator**
 As well as your native tongue, are you fluent in both written and spoken English? If yes, talk to us—your strong communication skills will surely land you the job.
   

  

**Having initiative**
 We’ll rely on you to create an environment where all team members are encouraged to contribute. We’ll also expect you to manage team members effectively, driving their enthusiastic and effective contribution to every project. Finally, looking out for and taking action on improvement opportunities should come second nature to you.

The Project Manager role will be responsible for setting up new Centers across different business formats, capacity expansion of existing facilities as well as relocation of facilities as per business requirements. * Ensure Safe Execution and Zero LTIs in all the projects
* Ensure adherence to Safety and Statutory compliance in all the projects : \>95%
* Ensure completion and rollout of the specific project management initiatives on time in full

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in engineering including a supervisory role managing people
* Experience in a fast\-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
* Experience in project management


**Preferred Qualifications**

description:
**Description**
 If you are looking for an opportunity to solve deep technical problems and drive large\-scale cross\-functional initiatives in a fast\-paced environment working with smart, passionate engineers and business leaders, this might be the role for you.
   

  

 Within the Transportation Technology and Services organization, Relay Central delivers a seamless, intelligent, and trusted foundation that empowers Amazon’s middle mile carriers to thrive in a fast\-moving, complex environment. We believe that great products and experiences should enable carriers to focus on what matters most — safety, reliability, operational excellence, and growing their business with Amazon.
   

  

 Relay Central’s mission is to help carriers succeed while insisting on the highest standards across safety, compliance, trust, and delivery quality. We are building the systems, experiences, and operational mechanisms that simplify complexity, reduce friction, and create confidence for carriers operating within Amazon’s transportation network.
   

  

 By unifying essential capabilities into one cohesive experience, we enable smooth onboarding, effective trip management, trusted operational support, and engaging loyalty experiences. Our vision is to become the trusted control tower for carriers — delivering the right insights, tools, and intelligent experiences that unlock carrier potential and help shape the future of transportation.
   

  

 Our team is actively seeking motivated and multi\-talented individuals who are passionate about reinventing and transforming transportation and logistics operations while maintaining a relentless focus on customer trust and operational excellence.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead complex, cross\-functional programs that power the Relay Central platform and carrier experience. You will partner closely with engineering, product, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions that improve carrier success while upholding Amazon’s high bar for quality, reliability, and customer trust.
   

  

 You will own roadmap planning, dependency management, execution mechanisms, and delivery for strategic initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations. This role requires strong technical depth, excellent judgment, and the ability to influence across organizations. You should be a self\-starter with a bias for action who can balance long\-term vision with operational rigor in highly ambiguous environments.
   

  

 Successful candidates will have a proven track record of driving large\-scale technical programs, simplifying complex problems, and delivering measurable business impact while maintaining high standards in execution.

 Lead large\-scale technical programs and strategic initiatives across Relay Central and partner organizations

 Drive roadmap planning, execution tracking, dependency management, and release coordination across multiple teams
   

  

 Work backwards from carrier and business needs to influence product and technical direction
   

  

 Identify risks proactively and drive alignment across technical and non\-technical stakeholders
   

  

 Communicate program status, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to senior leadership and partner teams
   

  

 Use data\-driven decision making to improve customer outcomes and operational performance
   

  

 Help build a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and high standards across teams
   

  

 Professional traits that are not unique to this position, but necessary for Amazon leaders
   

  

 Exhibits excellent judgment
   

  

 Earns trust across technical and business teams
   

  

 Has relentlessly high standards and insists on operational excellence
   

  

 Is able to dive deep and stay connected to both business and technical details
   

  

 Thinks strategically while maintaining strong execution focus
   

  

 Demonstrates strong ownership and bias for action
   

  

 Has passion and conviction and the ability to inspire others
   

  

 Thinks big while remaining customer obsessed
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline
   

  

 3\+ years of technical program management experience working directly with software engineering teams
   

  

 Experience managing large\-scale cross\-functional technical programs
   

  

 Experience driving roadmap strategy, execution planning, and release coordination
   

  

 Experience working with distributed systems and scalable software architectures
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
   

  

 Experience that will make you successful in this role
   

  

 Strong technical depth with the ability to engage deeply with engineers and architects
   

  

 Proven track record of delivering complex technical initiatives in fast\-paced environments
   

  

 Ability to influence across organizations and align diverse stakeholders toward common goals
   

  

 Experience defining mechanisms and processes that improve execution at scale
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail

 Passion for improving customer and carrier experiences through technology and operational excellence
   

  

 Experience in transportation, logistics, marketplace, or operational technology domains is a plus
